description: This file contains functions and type definitions related to model selection, context window evaluation, and hook execution within an agent setup process for an AI system. It manages plugin hooks, model configuration, and context window constraints.

methods.name: resolveHookModelSelection
methods.description: Resolves the model and provider override based on plugin hooks, allowing plugins to modify the model selection process.

methods.name: resolveEffectiveRuntimeModel
methods.description: Calculates the effective runtime model considering context window constraints and returns context info along with the adjusted model.
